title: Australia went to war with emus. The emus won.
description:
In 1932 the Australian army sent machine guns to fight about 20,000 emus. It did not go well.

Sources:
- Encyclopaedia Britannica, Emu War: https://www.britannica.com/event/Emu-War
- Libby Robin, Emu: national symbols and ecological limits (ANU): https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/server/api/core/bitstreams/c76f8ca1-5e83-4be7-981a-c7e9e2689bd0/content
- Australian Geographic, Looking back: Australia's Emu Wars: https://www.australiangeographic.com.au/nature-wildlife/2016/10/australias-emu-wars/
- Wikipedia, Emu War (and Johnson 2006, Journal of Australian Studies, which it cites): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emu_War

The kill count is Major Meredith's own claim.
